Name: Goodbye SMAPI
Author: JessebotX
Description:
I recommend you to also check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4483]Hello SMAPI[/url]
This mod also closes your game if you say goodbye (or one of the Command Inputs found in the config.json) to SMAPI

[b][size=5]Features[/size][/b]
[list][*]Type [font=Courier New]bye[/font] or [font=Courier New]goodbye[/font] in the SMAPI console to get a response and close your game right after
[*]Have the best goodbye's ever. Many responses that you can add or delete in the config.json
[*]Want more ways to say goodbye to SMAPI, configure the command inputs in the config.json. (Default: [font=Courier New]bye[/font] and [font=Courier New]goodbye[/font])
[/list]

[b][size=5]Usage[/size][/b]
Type in a command input (default: [font=Courier New]bye[/font] or [font=Courier New]goodbye[/font]) in the SMAPI console and get a response (also configurable) from the SMAPI console

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[b]Dependencies[/b]
[list][*][url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b][/url] [REQUIRED] - The Stardew Valley Mod Loader
[*]Console Commands [REQUIRED] - If you install SMAPI, you will get the Console Commands mod since it comes with SMAPI (unless you deleted Console Commands from your Mods folder; to solve this problem simply reinstall SMAPI)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4483]Hello SMAPI[/url]﻿ [RECOMMENDED] - You can also say hello to smapi

[/list]

[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1][*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Download this mod and extract/unzip into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder
[/list]

need help?: Check out the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Player's Guide to Installing and Using Mods[/url] and the [url=https://discord.com/invite/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley Discord[/url]

[b]Uninstallation[/b]
[list][*]Delete this mod (folder name is [font=Courier New]Goodbye SMAPI[/font]) from your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder
[/list]

[b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]
Run the game once with mod installed to generate a config.json in the [font=Courier New]Mods/Goodbye SMAPI[/font] folder

When you open the config.json file, you will first notice 2 lists: CommandInput and Responses. CommandInput is the command you type in the SMAPI Console to trigger a Response from the Responses list. You can edit, delete or add more items in these lists.

If you know the json [w/comments] format, you can start configuring. If you don't, read this entire section.

Notice how each list wraps its items in {curly brackets} ? Go in between these to add, delete or edit the items.

Notice how each item in a list is wrapped with "quotation marks" and then there will be a comma at the end of the quotation marks? These quotation marks and the comma are important because your items you add must be wrapped around these.

To add, simply put a comma at the end of the last item in the list and then type in this
[font=Courier New]"INSERT YOUR QUOTE HERE"[/font]

To delete, simply delete the quote along with the quotation marks and the comma at the end.
To edit, simply change the string of text in between the quotation marks.

Dont Understand? Visit the [url=https://discord.com/invite/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley Discord[/url] or the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/SMAPI/]SMAPI subreddit[/url] for help
